+"""Visual, incremental controller for the RoboLab snack episode.
+
+The script keeps an action log and snapshots in /app/output.  Run one command at
+a time so the next target can be checked against the latest camera image.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+QUAT_DOWN = [-2.980232e-7, -0.70710683, 0.70710695, 1.788139e-7]
+
+
+def connect():
+    return Robot()
+
+
+def save_result(r, res, label, action):
+    entry = {
+        "time": time.time(),
+        "label": label,
+        "action": action,
+        "status": r.status(),
+        "meta": {k: v for k, v in res.meta.items() if k != "cameras"},
+    }
+    with (OUT / "trajectory.jsonl").open("a") as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
+    for cam, frame in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"latest_{cam}.jpg", quality=90)
+    print(json.dumps({"status": entry["status"], "tcp": res.meta["proprio"]["now"][8:15],
+                      "gripper_opening": res.meta["proprio"]["now"][24],
+                      "plan": res.meta.get("plan"), "clipped": res.meta.get("clipped"),
+                      "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s")}, indent=2))
+
+
+def move(r, xyz, close, label):
+    target = [*xyz, *QUAT_DOWN, float(close)]
+    before = r.status()["control_steps"]
+    try:
+        res = r.submit("ee_pose", [target], video="none", note=label)
+    except Exception:
+        r.wait_ready()
+        print("Move may have executed; steps before/after:", before, r.status()["control_steps"])
+        raise
+    save_result(r, res, label, {"type": "ee_pose", "target": target})
+
+
+def grip(r, close, seconds, label):
+    p = r.get_obs().meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    q = p[:7]
+    n = max(2, int(round(seconds * 15)))
+    actions = np.tile(np.array([*q, float(close)], dtype=np.float32), (n, 1))
+    before = r.status()["control_steps"]
+    try:
+        res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=1/15, video="none", note=label)
+    except Exception:
+        r.wait_ready()
+        print("Grip may have executed; steps before/after:", before, r.status()["control_steps"])
+        raise
+    save_result(r, res, label, {"type": "joint_position_hold", "close": close, "seconds": seconds})
+
+
+def snapshot(r, label):
+    res = r.get_obs(depth=True)
+    save_result(r, res, label, {"type": "get_obs"})
+    for cam, depth in res.last_depth.items():
+        np.save(OUT / f"latest_{cam}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (OUT / "latest_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+    p = sub.add_parser("move")
+    p.add_argument("x", type=float); p.add_argument("y", type=float); p.add_argument("z", type=float)
+    p.add_argument("close", type=int); p.add_argument("label")
